items.title: Caddi
items.name: Caddi
items.summary: Agent that builds agents by only showing your work only once
items.description: Caddi turns narrated screenshares into production agents that run back-office work across your real tools. Show the task once, and Caddi learns the process, builds the automation, and lets you update it in plain English. Unlike RPA or workflow builders that require scoping, developers, and step-by-step setup, Caddi combines AI reasoning with deterministic execution, with every run logged and every permission scoped.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Jason, one of the makers of Caddi. Caddi is an agent that builds agents.

We build for law firms, RIAs and accounting firms, and the same thing kept coming up: the work isn't hard, it's just endless. A contract comes back signed, someone downloads it, renames it to the firm convention, files it to the matter, logs it in the CRM. Forty times a month. Every month.

Automating that has always meant a project. Scope it, spec it, configure it, get a developer. So it never happens, and people keep doing it by hand.

Caddi takes a different path, and it starts before you build anything: it reads your stack and tells you which work you repeat most, ranked by impact.

You pick one, and then you teach it like a new hire, except this new hire already knows the job. It follows your guidance or guides you with best practices, and probes for edge-cases: not just "download the contract", but "say how you tell an executed copy from a draft".

When it hits something ambiguous it stops and asks, with the options laid out and a confirm button. What if only one party has signed? Your answer doesn't disappear into a transcript. It becomes a rule in the agent.

What comes out reasons with AI where judgment is needed and runs deterministic code where it isn't, so the messy cases get handled without the exact parts going off-script. Then it runs in the cloud, executing thousands of actions at a time.

And you can see all of it. Every run is a log of what it decided, step by step, with the permission it used to do it: read, create, send.

We'd genuinely love your feedback, especially on where you'd trust an agent and where you wouldn't. That line is the whole product for us.
The screen share to agent workflow feels very thoughtfully designed. It removes a lot of the friction that normally comes with setting up automation from scratch.

The interesting change here is not just AI automation, but also turning traditional workflows into something reusable. This could lead to the automation of many documentless business processes in the future. This is a great idea.

items.title: ChatCut Desktop
items.name: ChatCut Desktop
items.summary: Video editor built for humans & AI. Edit with GPT & Claude.
items.description: Introducing ChatCut Desktop, the AI video editor built for humans and agents to edit together. Use ChatCut’s built-in agent, or connect ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code. Say how you want your video edited and watch them happen on a fully editable timeline. Edit footage, create motion graphics and captions, generate video, images, music and SFX, and save reusable editing skills. Everything runs locally, and you stay in control. Export XML to Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.
top_comments:
Hi Product Hunt!

Last month, we launched our ChatGPT/Codex plugin and received incredible support from this community.


One of the most consistent pieces of feedback was that you loved being able to connect your own agent, but wanted to work with larger files and have a faster, more reliable editing experience.

So we built ChatCut Desktop.

It includes everything you can do with our web app and plugin, but in a local environment. Your footage stays on your computer, and editing and exporting happen locally. You can use ChatCut’s built-in agent or connect your existing ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code subscription and use the tokens you already pay for, making ChatCut’s core editing features free to use. A ChatCut subscription is only required for pro features such as Seedance and Kling video generation, XML export, AI voice generation, and voice cloning.

Today, ChatCut is used by creators editing talking-head videos, tiktoks, reels and shorts, businesses producing ads and branded content, companies creating social content, internal videos and product updates, and AI filmmakers making films.

Give ChatCut Desktop a try, and please send us any feedback, suggestions, or questions at team@chatcut.io.

We’d love to hear what you think. Go create something!

using the tokens I already pay for is a smart model, but curious how it works for a heavy edit - like "cut every silence and add captions" on a 40 minute file. does the agent send the whole timeline/transcript context to Claude Code or Codex for that, or is the actual cutting/rendering done locally and the LLM just issues a small set of instructions? asking because that's the difference between it being basically free and it quietly eating a chunk of my daily token budget on one video.

items.title: Caddi
items.name: Caddi
items.summary: Agent that builds agents by only showing your work only once
items.description: Caddi turns narrated screenshares into production agents that run back-office work across your real tools. Show the task once, and Caddi learns the process, builds the automation, and lets you update it in plain English. Unlike RPA or workflow builders that require scoping, developers, and step-by-step setup, Caddi combines AI reasoning with deterministic execution, with every run logged and every permission scoped.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt 👋

I'm Jason, one of the makers of Caddi. Caddi is an agent that builds agents.

We build for law firms, RIAs and accounting firms, and the same thing kept coming up: the work isn't hard, it's just endless. A contract comes back signed, someone downloads it, renames it to the firm convention, files it to the matter, logs it in the CRM. Forty times a month. Every month.

Automating that has always meant a project. Scope it, spec it, configure it, get a developer. So it never happens, and people keep doing it by hand.

Caddi takes a different path, and it starts before you build anything: it reads your stack and tells you which work you repeat most, ranked by impact.

You pick one, and then you teach it like a new hire, except this new hire already knows the job. It follows your guidance or guides you with best practices, and probes for edge-cases: not just "download the contract", but "say how you tell an executed copy from a draft".

When it hits something ambiguous it stops and asks, with the options laid out and a confirm button. What if only one party has signed? Your answer doesn't disappear into a transcript. It becomes a rule in the agent.

What comes out reasons with AI where judgment is needed and runs deterministic code where it isn't, so the messy cases get handled without the exact parts going off-script. Then it runs in the cloud, executing thousands of actions at a time.

And you can see all of it. Every run is a log of what it decided, step by step, with the permission it used to do it: read, create, send.

We'd genuinely love your feedback, especially on where you'd trust an agent and where you wouldn't. That line is the whole product for us.
The screen share to agent workflow feels very thoughtfully designed. It removes a lot of the friction that normally comes with setting up automation from scratch.

The interesting change here is not just AI automation, but also turning traditional workflows into something reusable. This could lead to the automation of many documentless business processes in the future. This is a great idea.

items.title: ChatCut Desktop
items.name: ChatCut Desktop
items.summary: Video editor built for humans & AI. Edit with GPT & Claude.
items.description: Introducing ChatCut Desktop, the AI video editor built for humans and agents to edit together. Use ChatCut’s built-in agent, or connect ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code. Say how you want your video edited and watch them happen on a fully editable timeline. Edit footage, create motion graphics and captions, generate video, images, music and SFX, and save reusable editing skills. Everything runs locally, and you stay in control. Export XML to Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut.
top_comments:
Hi Product Hunt!

Last month, we launched our ChatGPT/Codex plugin and received incredible support from this community.


One of the most consistent pieces of feedback was that you loved being able to connect your own agent, but wanted to work with larger files and have a faster, more reliable editing experience.

So we built ChatCut Desktop.

It includes everything you can do with our web app and plugin, but in a local environment. Your footage stays on your computer, and editing and exporting happen locally. You can use ChatCut’s built-in agent or connect your existing ChatGPT/Codex or Claude Code subscription and use the tokens you already pay for, making ChatCut’s core editing features free to use. A ChatCut subscription is only required for pro features such as Seedance and Kling video generation, XML export, AI voice generation, and voice cloning.

Today, ChatCut is used by creators editing talking-head videos, tiktoks, reels and shorts, businesses producing ads and branded content, companies creating social content, internal videos and product updates, and AI filmmakers making films.

Give ChatCut Desktop a try, and please send us any feedback, suggestions, or questions at team@chatcut.io.

We’d love to hear what you think. Go create something!

using the tokens I already pay for is a smart model, but curious how it works for a heavy edit - like "cut every silence and add captions" on a 40 minute file. does the agent send the whole timeline/transcript context to Claude Code or Codex for that, or is the actual cutting/rendering done locally and the LLM just issues a small set of instructions? asking because that's the difference between it being basically free and it quietly eating a chunk of my daily token budget on one video.

interest_sections.title: 法律 AI 工作流
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub：法律 AI 已有集成平台的苗头，但社交讨论仍停留在单点工具和个案，整合式工作流尚未成为主流。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 律师在合同审核上耗时过长，需要 AI 直接完成合同审查、文书生成和法规检索等具体任务

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前社交讨论仍以通用 AI 工具（如 DeepSeek）单点生成内容为主，现有法律 AI 如 LexAI 虽已集成合同审查、文书生成，但讨论较少。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 将 LLM 与法律数据库（如得理 API）结合，构建从合同审查到文书生成的可对话工作流。

product_items.title: abaiar/-LexAI
product_items.highlight_one_liner: LLM 智能法律咨询与文书平台
product_items.reuse_direction: 把「法律 AI 工作流」封装成更明确的岗位或任务入口
product_items.minimal_mvp: 先围绕“律师在合同审核上耗时过长，需要 AI 直接完成合同审查、文书生成和法规检索等具体任务”做单任务 MVP，优先打通输入、执行和结果回传

interest_sections.title: 教育 AI 辅导
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自xiaohongshu，老师对AI工具的真实吐槽点在于输出不够完整（缺图片动画）和非教学杂务未被覆盖，说明工作流整合比“多推荐一个工具”更关键。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 老师急需能直接产出可修改教案、PPT和自动批改作业的AI，同时减轻写简报、家访记录等非教学杂务

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前大家在小红书记录和推荐DeepSeek、今天学点啥、SmartPrep、Gradescope、Otter等工具，主要围绕从文字生成教案PPT和按评分标准批改，但PPT缺图片动画、免费与否等细节仍靠个人摸索。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是AI从“产出文字教案/PPT初稿”扩展到“自动配图配音、生成逐字稿和多媒体课堂素材”，以及把简报、家访记录等行政事务纳入备课流程。

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub，核心观察是AI模拟面试需求真实但免费工具稀缺，用户既依赖专门的面试工具也尝试用通用模型自建流程，个性化定制和免费可及是下一步关注点。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 求职者和保研学生在面试前需要针对个人简历和岗位/专业进行模拟问答，并得到针对性的反馈和建议，同时希望工具免费可用

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前用户主要通过offergoose、智面星等专门工具完成“上传简历-选择岗位-AI提问-生成报告”，也有用户直接用豆包、Deepseek等通用模型DIY模拟面试；评论区在对比工具免费额度并寻找替代。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是让AI模拟面试从标准问答升级为“基于个人材料智能生成个性化追问、结合岗位能力模型给出改进建议”，并探索用通用聊天模型搭定制化提示词流程以绕开付费门槛。

product_items.title: spontaneousai/job-hunt-copilot
product_items.highlight_one_liner: AI 求职定制简历与面试稿生成
product_items.reuse_direction: 把「AI 面试官 / 工作流自动化」封装成更明确的岗位或任务入口
product_items.minimal_mvp: 先围绕“求职者和保研学生在面试前需要针对个人简历和岗位/专业进行模拟问答，并得到针对性的反馈和建议，同时希望工具免费可用”做单任务 MVP，优先打通输入、执行和结果回传

interest_sections.title: AI 应用场景 / 数据
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、zhihu，产品经理的工具需求正从单点效率转向整合AI的全流程工作流，成本控制成为新焦点。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 产品经理希望用一套低，并避免AI调用

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前普遍用墨刀/Figma做原型、Xmind/ProcessOn做流程、Kimi/豆包做总结，再靠boardmix这类白板整合，社区在交流工具组合和API成本问题。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 可跟踪按任务场景自动编排的AI工作流，将录音转文本、长文总结、思维导图和原型协作串成一条链，同时内嵌成本预估。
